findings.message: CMake platform condition `CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux" OR CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME S...` has no QNX case
findings.suggestion: This branch selects sources, flags or libraries per platform but never names QNX. QNX toolchain files set CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME to QNX (and often QNX TRUE), and QNX notes that CMake conditionals checking CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME need to be extended for QNX; decide whether QNX belongs in this condition (e.g. add `AND NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "QNX"` or an elseif branch).

findings.message: Platform branch for __APPLE__ has no __QNX__ case

findings.message: Linux epoll header <sys/epoll.h>
findings.suggestion: QNX 8.0 documents ionotify() as corresponding to Linux epoll(); poll()/select() are also available. No epoll page exists in the QNX 8.0 C Library Reference. A libepoll is listed in the com.qnx.<baselineId>.target.screen.notify_fd package (documented for Wayland on Screen); verify it is in your SDP before relying on it.

findings.message: Linux eventfd header <sys/eventfd.h>
findings.suggestion: eventfd is not in the QNX 8.0 C Library Reference; libeventfd is listed only in the screen.notify_fd package (Wayland on Screen). Otherwise replace with a pipe()/pipe2() wake-up fd watched by poll().
